newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share index surges 0.6 pct to new record.
newsitem.headline: NZ share index surges 0.6 pct to new record.

text.p: New Zealand's top 40 share market index, spurred by lower bond yields, surged 0.66 percent to its highest point since 1991 in active Wednesday trade.
By 10.10 a.m. (2210 GMT) the NZSE-40 Capital Index was up 16.40 points at 2,507.26, surpassing Monday's record of 2,501.96.
At current levels the index is at its highest since its inception in 1991. Compared to the index's predecessor, the Barclays Index, the market is at a post-1987 share market crash high.
